name: altbieratlas
description: Die interaktive Karte des Altbiers — Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts._comment_db_name: Alle db:*-Scripts nutzen $D1_NAME (Shell-Variable). Default: my-d1-database. Vor Gebrauch z.B. setzen: `export D1_NAME=meine-db` — oder inline: `D1_NAME=meine-db npm run db:create`.
scripts.db:setup:local: npm run db:schema:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:setup:remote: npm run db:schema:remote && npm run db:seed:remote
